evidence: Walked all 2 gate criteria, 15 functional criteria (61 weight), 5 polish and 5 visual likert criteria against the frozen golden source. No leg found that the reference cannot pass. Seeded figures quoted by criteria all match seed_data.json: Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist(1), Ade Bello(2), Marco Rossi(3); Screen Priya Nair(1), Samuel Ortiz(2); Noor's APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; APP-101 has 120 messages, page size 30; Lena APP-301 has 3 messages, read_count 2, third from USR-REC3 so unread = 1 (hro_unread_seen); Noor Platform Engineer INTERVIEW -> 'Interviewing', Product Designer APPLIED -> 'Application received', Tomas Data Analyst SCREEN -> 'In review' (hro_candidate). db.js seedIfEmpty skips when users exist (no reseed after restart). Per-criterion source trace (index.js unless stated): - gates: login 401 on bad password (l.87) and app.js shows error; add-candidate + reload + Observer read via /api/bootstrap. - hro_intake_restart: blank title via text() (l.62-66); places 0/51 rejected by l.207; '2.5' -> board.js l.72 regex yields NaN -> JSON null -> rejected; Recruiter-as-manager replay rejected by role check l.205; invalid/different-case email -> details.field=candidate_email (l.222-224), board.js l.53 marks field and keeps name/email/source; new cards at bottom (l.229); restart keeps everything (SQLite + DB_PATH, test.sh/restart helper identical to template). - hro_moves / hro_reject_reopen: checkMove l.238-265 (one stage, reason required, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to rejected_from); optimistic localMove (board.js l.172-186) shows the move at once; unoffered skips/reopens are covered by prompt.md's 'record not offered and replay' rule and the server refuses; undo restores rejected_from/reject_reason (l.302-303, 365); reopen into full Interview refused by l.291-295. - hro_two_people: stale version -> 409 with ' was changed by someone else (Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)' (l.241-245); SSE 'changed' on every successful write (l.48-53) -> refresh within ~300 ms. - hro_interview_places: limit l.291-295; failed send puts card back, shows alert and focuses the card's select (board.js l.191-198, fail l.166-171); undo overfill refused l.357-359 and later allowed. - hro_bulk: board-order ranking l.284-288 gives Y,W,X and A2,V; per-card rules and whole-set Interview count; skip-first (step 4) and skip-last (step 8) both refused atomically in one immediate transaction. - hro_undo: version_after check l.354-355 refuses after another person's move/re-order/reject/reopen; notes do not bump version so step 5 proceeds; undone flag + latest-action id make repeat/replayed undo 409. - hro_activity: log() per card for add/move/reject(with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo and JOB_OPENED; ORDER BY id DESC; job filter in app.js l.65; refused actions roll back in the transaction. - hro_manager_roles: manager rule l.257-264 (Interview/Offer/Hired only, own job; Screen-origin reopen refused); multi-card set with a Screen card refused 403; Bill's move/note 403 (l.258, 394); Observer reads notes (STAFF in l.387). - hro_readonly_roles: auth()/mayMove/staffOnly yield Observer 403, candidate 403 or 404 for others, anonymous 401 for every listed replay. - hro_messaging / hro_drafts: textContent rendering (app.js el l.12) shows plain literally, .message .body white-space: pre-wrap (styles.css l.105) keeps line break; Enter/Shift+Enter (threads.js l.184); box cleared and refocused (l.196-201); drafts per user+conversation in localStorage (app.js keep l.39-43, threads.js l.113,125,183); Ingrid 403, Aud read-only, Noor 404 (threadAccess l.114-131). - hro_long_thread / hro_pol_earlier_place: latest 30 + earlier_count (l.409-416); prepend with scrollTop compensation (threads.js l.168-172); scrolled-up arrival -> pending pill, no markRead (l.152-159); sending marks read up to own id (l.425) so unread 0. - hro_unread_seen: unread excludes own messages (l.133); Observer never counts toward seen (seenBoundary l.143-150); inactive threads view (Board) never marks read (threads.js l.152,158,211). - hro_candidate: candidate read model l.171-176 (no notes, reasons, positions, other candidates); SSE payload is 'data: 1'; other application -> 404. - polish: live_board keeps detail/note/focus (renderBoard refocus guard board.js l.323-339; detail not rebuilt); failed_send fetch failure -> status 0 'Not sent...' with box kept (app.js l.31, threads.js l.195); session_resume: 401 -> sessionLost() login prompt, drafts keyed by user id so Mei sees none. Measured evidence (scripted, not judge): via-solve.log shows solve.sh installed 11 files and 26 driver groups PASS against the frozen bytes with a real kill/relaunch restart, including stale move naming Mei Lin, full-Interview put-back with focus, bulk+undo through the page, live board note/focus, 30-at-a-time paging with place kept (<2 px), arrival while scrolled up, Enter/Shift+Enter and literal , seen receipts, Lena unread 1, session-ended draft resume, observer read-only, restart without reseed. Lessons-file patterns checked for this row: L19 (golden harness must cover every criterion leg) — partially met, see gaps; L7/L8 modifier-click and timing — golden uses checkboxes, so no modifier is needed and live updates are SSE-fast; L15 restart — golden persists all state; L9 judge over-passes — not a golden-coverage issue. Broken app that could pass this row's concern: none relevant (row 18 concerns the reference). Conforming-alternative probe: an app that refuses unoffered skips only in the UI is still graded via replay per prompt.md, and the golden's server refuses them, so the golden is not penalised. Why risk=true: (1) No configured judge run, Oracle grade or full-suite measurement exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so); 'oracle can score high' is source-plausible only. (2) Legs the scripted driver does not exercise, established only by source reading: places 0/51/2.5 and Recruiter-as-manager refusals; restart via the restart_app MCP tool (driver used kill/relaunch); hro_pol_live_board scroll offset within 2 px on a scrolled board (driver never made the board scroll); hro_pol_failed_send aborted request; Mei not seeing Rafael's unsaved note draft and Rafael's note draft surviving; hro_long_thread own-reply-while-scrolled-up unread 0; hro_unread_seen on a new job managed by Bill with Rafael on the Board; Ingrid's multi-card refusal and Bill's note refusal; candidate status walk Not moving forward -> Hired. (3) Minor cosmetic observation: after sending while scrolled up, threads.js markRead (l.104) returns early when a.unread is already 0, so the '1 new message' pill can remain while the unread count reads 0 if the scroll event lands after refresh; the bar grades the count, so not a failure, but a strict judge could misread it.
